text:
Predicates:
Romance(x) ::: x is a Romance language.
IndoEuropean(x) ::: x is an Indo-European language.
LanguageFamily(x, y) ::: x is a language within the language family y.
Related(x, y) ::: x is related to y.
French ::: the French language.
Spanish ::: the Spanish language.
German ::: the German language.
Basque ::: the Basque language.

Premises:
∀x (Romance(x) → IndoEuropean(x)) ::: All Romance languages are Indo-European languages.
∀x (Romance(x) → LanguageFamily(x, romanceFamily)) ::: The Romance languages are a language family.
∀x ∀y (LanguageFamily(x, family) ∧ Language(y, family) → Related(x, y)) ::: All languages within a language family are related to each other.
Romance(French) ∧ Romance(Spanish) ::: French and Spanish are both Romance languages.
Related(German, Spanish) ::: German is related to Spanish.
¬Related(Basque, y) ::: Basque is not related to any other language.

Conclusion:
IndoEuropean(French) ::: French is an Indo-European language.
